profile.name: SocketCAN总线接口
profile.description: 基于 Linux SocketCAN 的 CAN 总线软件通信接口，用于在实验系统中发送 CAN 报文、管理周期发送任务并关闭总线套接字连接。它本身不是物理仪器，而是用于连接和控制 CAN 网络设备的非实体组件。
profile.description_en: A Linux SocketCAN-based software communication interface for CAN bus messaging, periodic transmission task management, and socket shutdown in laboratory systems. It is not a physical instrument, but a non-physical component used to connect to and control devices on a CAN network.
